7d.no_validation_reason: 14d history + 7d labels first trains at D21. A disjoint 7d development window would end at D28, after D22 freeze. Fixed preregistered Ridge parameters; no validation/model selection.

limits: Power-domain utilization, not independent facility active-power meters or kW accuracy.
Three predeclared target domains; this is a pilot, not all 57 LODO folds.
7d windows overlap; 7d has only two final training windows per complete source and no disjoint development set before D22.
No HAST, source gating, target fine-tuning or pretrained unseen-domain claim.
Historical Google experiments have already been observed; this new identity is not a newly collected untouched dataset.

historical_protection.policy: Existing files only; additions allowed. SHA256 when recorded, otherwise size/mtime. No protection claim beyond these checks.

user_work_protection.baseline_capture_note: Artifact scanning started before implementation. Source_files/status fields were captured at the end, not as an original-code snapshot. Original main status is recorded separately in CROSS_DOMAIN_REFACTOR_AUDIT.md.

figure_note: Regenerated from the saved metrics with a common 0-to-global-maximum color scale; no retraining or re-scoring.
